resources.name: Decks API
resources.description: API collection for auth and deck management endpoints.

resources.name: Auth
resources.description: Sign-up, sign-in, and sign-out. Cookies are managed automatically by Insomnia's Cookie Jar — run Sign In first, then all deck requests will include the session cookie.

resources.name: Sign Up
resources.description:
POST /api/auth/signup

Registers a new user. Accepts multipart/form-data with email + password.
On success the server redirects to /auth/confirm-email — the user must verify their email before signing in.

Responses:
- 302 → /auth/confirm-email   on success
- 302 → /auth/signup?error=…  on Supabase error (e.g. email already in use)

headers.name: Origin
headers.description: Required: Astro's built-in CSRF check (security.checkOrigin) blocks POST without a matching Origin header.

resources.name: Sign In
resources.description:
POST /api/auth/signin

Authenticates an existing user. Accepts multipart/form-data with email + password.
Supabase sets an HttpOnly session cookie (sb-*-auth-token) via Set-Cookie. Insomnia stores it in the Cookie Jar automatically and sends it on all subsequent requests to the same origin.

Responses:
- 302 → /           on success (session cookie set)
- 302 → /auth/signin?error=…  on bad credentials or config error

Cookie handling:
  Insomnia follows the redirect and stores the Set-Cookie headers in the Default Jar.
  All subsequent requests to {{ _.base_url }} will include those cookies automatically.

headers.name: Origin
headers.description: Required: Astro's built-in CSRF check (security.checkOrigin) blocks POST without a matching Origin header.

resources.name: Sign Out
resources.description:
POST /api/auth/signout

Invalidates the current session on the Supabase side and clears the session cookie.
No body required — the session is identified by the cookie already stored in the Cookie Jar.

Responses:
- 302 → /   (session cookie cleared)

headers.description: Required: Astro's built-in CSRF check (security.checkOrigin) blocks POST without a matching Origin header.

resources.name: Decks
resources.description: Endpoints for creating, listing, renaming, and deleting decks. Requires a valid session — run Auth → Sign In first.

resources.name: List Decks
resources.description:
GET /api/decks

Returns a paginated, sortable, and searchable list of the authenticated user's decks together with per-deck flashcard counters and deck-limit metadata.

Query parameters:
- limit   (integer 1–100, default 20)  — page size
- cursor  (string, optional)           — opaque cursor from a previous response's pagination.nextCursor
- sort    (createdAt|updatedAt|name, default createdAt)
- order   (asc|desc, default desc)
- search  (string, optional)           — case-insensitive substring filter on deck name

Responses:
- 200  ListDecksResponseDto
- 400  INVALID_QUERY   — bad query params or malformed/mismatched cursor
- 401  AUTH_REQUIRED
- 500  DECK_LIST_FAILED | CONFIG_ERROR

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor from pagination.nextCursor for the next page.

resources.name: Create Deck
resources.description:
POST /api/decks

Creates a new deck for the authenticated user and returns the created deck together with updated deck-limit metadata.

Request body (JSON):
- name  (string, required, 1–100 chars after trimming)

Responses:
- 201  CreateDeckResponseDto  { deck: DeckDto, limits: DeckLimitsDto }
- 400  INVALID_BODY | INVALID_DECK_NAME
- 401  AUTH_REQUIRED
- 403  FORBIDDEN_ORIGIN  — cross-origin request rejected (CSRF)
- 409  DECK_LIMIT_REACHED  — user already owns 120 decks
- 500  DECK_CREATE_FAILED | CONFIG_ERROR

headers.name: Origin
headers.description: Required: Astro's built-in CSRF check (security.checkOrigin) blocks POST without a matching Origin header.

resources.name: Rename Deck
resources.description:
PATCH /api/decks/{deckId}

Renames a deck owned by the authenticated user and returns the updated deck (including current flashcard counters).

Path parameters:
- deckId  (UUID, required)

Request body (JSON):
- name  (string, required, 1–100 chars after trimming)

Responses:
- 200  RenameDeckResponseDto  { deck: DeckDto }
- 400  INVALID_BODY | INVALID_DECK_NAME | INVALID_DECK_ID
- 401  AUTH_REQUIRED
- 403  FORBIDDEN_ORIGIN
- 404  DECK_NOT_FOUND
- 500  DECK_UPDATE_FAILED | CONFIG_ERROR

headers.name: Origin
headers.description: Required: Astro's built-in CSRF check (security.checkOrigin) blocks PATCH without a matching Origin header.

resources.name: Delete Deck
resources.description:
DELETE /api/decks/{deckId}

Permanently deletes a deck owned by the authenticated user. All flashcards belonging to the deck are removed via the ON DELETE CASCADE foreign key — no separate step is needed.

Path parameters:
- deckId  (UUID, required)

Responses:
- 200  DeleteDeckResponseDto  { message: "Deck deleted successfully" }
- 400  INVALID_DECK_ID
- 401  AUTH_REQUIRED
- 403  FORBIDDEN_ORIGIN
- 404  DECK_NOT_FOUND
- 500  DECK_DELETE_FAILED | CONFIG_ERROR

headers.name: Origin
headers.description: Required: Astro's built-in CSRF check (security.checkOrigin) blocks DELETE without a matching Origin header.

resources.name: Flashcards
resources.description: Endpoints for creating, editing, deleting one, and deleting all flashcards in a deck. Requires a valid session — run Auth → Sign In first. Set deck_id from a deck response and flashcard_id from a create/list flashcard response.

resources.name: Create Flashcard
resources.description:
POST /api/decks/{deckId}/flashcards

Creates one manual flashcard inside a deck owned by the authenticated user. Text is trimmed and must be plain text. Unknown body keys are rejected.

Path parameters:
- deckId  (UUID, required)

Request body (JSON):
- frontText  (string, required, 1–500 chars, plain text, at most two sentence-ending punctuation marks)
- backText   (string, required, 1–3000 chars, plain text)

Responses:
- 201  CreateFlashcardResponseDto  { flashcard: FlashcardDto }
- 400  INVALID_BODY | INVALID_FLASHCARD_TEXT | INVALID_DECK_ID
- 401  AUTH_REQUIRED
- 403  FORBIDDEN_ORIGIN
- 404  DECK_NOT_FOUND
- 500  FLASHCARD_CREATE_FAILED | CONFIG_ERROR

headers.name: Origin
headers.description: Required: Astro's built-in CSRF check (security.checkOrigin) blocks POST without a matching Origin header.

resources.name: Edit Flashcard
resources.description:
PATCH /api/flashcards/{flashcardId}

Updates the text fields of a single flashcard owned by the authenticated user. Only frontText and/or backText may be changed. Deck membership, AI flag, SM-2 state, and timestamps are immutable through this endpoint.

Path parameters:
- flashcardId  (UUID, required)

Request body (JSON):
- frontText  (string, optional, 1–500 chars, plain text, at most two sentence-ending punctuation marks)
- backText   (string, optional, 1–3000 chars, plain text)

Responses:
- 200  UpdateFlashcardResponseDto  { flashcard: FlashcardDto }
- 400  INVALID_BODY | INVALID_FLASHCARD_TEXT | INVALID_FLASHCARD_ID | IMMUTABLE_FLASHCARD_FIELDS
- 401  AUTH_REQUIRED
- 403  FORBIDDEN_ORIGIN
- 404  FLASHCARD_NOT_FOUND
- 500  FLASHCARD_UPDATE_FAILED | CONFIG_ERROR

headers.name: Origin
headers.description: Required: Astro's built-in CSRF check (security.checkOrigin) blocks PATCH without a matching Origin header.

resources.name: Remove Flashcard
resources.description:
DELETE /api/flashcards/{flashcardId}

Permanently deletes a single flashcard owned by the authenticated user. The parent deck and other flashcards are preserved.

Path parameters:
- flashcardId  (UUID, required)

Responses:
- 200  DeleteFlashcardResponseDto  { message: "Flashcard deleted successfully" }
- 400  INVALID_FLASHCARD_ID
- 401  AUTH_REQUIRED
- 403  FORBIDDEN_ORIGIN
- 404  FLASHCARD_NOT_FOUND
- 500  FLASHCARD_DELETE_FAILED | CONFIG_ERROR

headers.name: Origin
headers.description: Required: Astro's built-in CSRF check (security.checkOrigin) blocks DELETE without a matching Origin header.

resources.name: Remove All Flashcards
resources.description:
DELETE /api/decks/{deckId}/flashcards

Permanently removes all flashcards from a deck owned by the authenticated user. The deck itself is preserved.

Path parameters:
- deckId  (UUID, required)

Responses:
- 200  ClearDeckFlashcardsResponseDto  { message: string, deletedCount: number }
- 400  INVALID_DECK_ID
- 401  AUTH_REQUIRED
- 403  FORBIDDEN_ORIGIN
- 404  DECK_NOT_FOUND
- 500  FLASHCARD_DELETE_FAILED | CONFIG_ERROR

headers.description: Required: Astro's built-in CSRF check (security.checkOrigin) blocks DELETE without a matching Origin header.
